author: THSV StreamBridge
description: Observes normalized public chat for bounded creator-configured safety signals without performing moderation actions.
changelog: 2.4.3: aligned with the stable THSV StreamBridge 2.4.3 baseline, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.4.2: initial disabled-by-default observe-only release with literal, normalized-domain, link, caps, repeated-character, length, and repeat-message signals; stable-ID and role trust controls; temporary hashed link permits; bounded pseudonymous incident state; authenticated aggregate capability/status; non-persisting rule tests; and confirmed/false-positive review labels.

manifest.name: Chat Guard
installationSteps: Install Chat Guard, review every observe-only rule, and leave it disabled until the preview matches your community.
Enable it to collect bounded pseudonymous incident metadata. No moderation action is performed.
uninstallationSteps: Uninstall the add-on. Its private pseudonymous incident state remains preserved for a later reinstall or creator review.

healthChecks.description: Confirms bounded observe-only public-chat classification is available without moderation authority.
